OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: API key from [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys). Used for extract, classify, and recall synthesis (`openai/gpt-5.6-luna`).

MEMORY_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for all `/namespaces/*` routes. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

MEMORY_PROFILE.description: SQLite Durable Object class — one instance per `namespace:profile`.

EXTRACT_QUEUE.description: Queue for idle-batch memory extraction after `POST .../queue`.

VECTORIZE.description: Vectorize index for semantic + HyDE recall (`bge-m3`, 1024 dims).
